title: Balanced Surge Fabric: Predictive Microtranche Allocation for Cross-Functional Cycles
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem: Mid-cycle reallocations and ad-hoc surge requests repeatedly cause context switching and delivery drag across engineering, infra, and product. We lack a lightweight predictive mechanism to reserve small, time-boxed capacity 'microtranches' that can be dispatched to urgent work without derailing committed deliverables.

Goal: Design and pilot a Balanced Surge Fabric — a prescriptive workflow + lightweight tooling that: (1) uses historical burn and signals (on-call incidents, customer escalations, usage spikes) to predict micro-surge demand; (2) offers a transparent ledger of reserved microtranches (2-5 person-days each) per cycle; (3) defines rules for activation, deactivation, and compensation to minimize impact on committed scope.

Scope: Create PM playbook, acceptance rules, a simple cycle ledger spreadsheet and a lightweight Console dashboard view (read-only for eng leads) showing allocated vs available microtranches. Prototype allocation algorithm (heuristic) and test during one pilot cycle with two cross-functional squads. Excludes full automation of staff reassignments and payroll adjustments — those are follow-ups.

Why now: Increased enterprise Dedicated onboarding and frequent private deployment incidents have surfaced unpredictable short-duration work that is expensive to triage mid-cycle. This reduces velocity and increases risk of missed SLAs. The pilot aims to preserve delivery cadence while absorbing necessary burst work with minimal overhead.
acceptance_criteria: Playbook drafted and reviewed by Eng, Design, and SRE (document link in comments)
Cycle ledger template created and adopted by pilot squads (spreadsheet link)
Console dashboard prototype shows microtranche counts per team and a 3-week forecast (read-only view)
Activation rules defined (who can greenlight a microtranche activation and when rollback occurs)
Pilot run completed for one full two-week cycle with retrospective and quantitative metrics (velocity delta <= 8% for committed work)
Stakeholder sign-off from Head of Product and Eng Director to proceed to broader rollout
decisions: Microtranche size set to 3 person-days by default, configurable per-squad
Reserve pool capped at 6 microtranches organization-wide for pilot; squads can request up to 2 each
Activation requires triage + sign-off from on-call SRE or Eng lead during hours, and PM approval for scope changes outside incident work
Compensation mechanism: microtranche usage logged and reconciled during next planning session; no automatic decommit unless >2 microtranches used against a squad in a cycle
tasks: Draft playbook and create triage flowcharts
Build cycle ledger template in Drive and add sample data
Prototype Console read-only dashboard with microtranche counts and forecast widget (frontend + mock API)
Define SLO for acceptable velocity impact and metric collection plan
Coordinate pilot with Squad Orion and Squad Nimbus; schedule kickoff and retro
Capture learnings and finalize roll/abort criteria
